declarations.name: charParseval_units
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
lemma charParseval_units {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (T : ZMod q → ℂ) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖∑ x : ZMod q, star (χ x) * T x‖ ^ 2) =
      (q.totient : ℝ) * ∑ x : ZMod q, (if IsUnit x then ‖T x‖ ^ 2 else 0)

declarations.name: bombieriDavenport_le
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem bombieriDavenport_le (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
        ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        (∑ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter (fun χ => χ.IsPrimitive),
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), a n * χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2))
      ≤ largeSieveBound N (1 / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: charOrthSum
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem charOrthSum {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (m n : ZMod q) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ m * star (χ n)) =
      if IsUnit m ∧ IsUnit n ∧ m = n then (q.totient : ℂ) else 0

declarations.name: zmodParseval_character
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem zmodParseval_character {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : ZMod q, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N),
        a n * if (n : ZMod q) = x then 1 else 0‖ ^ 2) =
      (1 / (q : ℝ)) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q,
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N),
          (charReal ((n : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) : ℂ) * a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: characterSieveModulus_le
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem characterSieveModulus_le {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), a n * χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q,
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N),
            (charReal ((n : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) : ℂ) * a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: largeSieveBound
declarations.complete_lexical_header: noncomputable def largeSieveBound (N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.complete_primitive_definition:
noncomputable def largeSieveBound (N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (N : ℝ) + (2 * (Nat.ceil (Real.log (1 / δ) / Real.log 2) : ℝ) + 12) / δ

theorem weighted_primitive_bombieri_davenport (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ)
    (N Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        ∑ χ : PrimitiveCharacter q,
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N),
            b n * χ.1 (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      largeSieveBound N (1 / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖b n‖ ^ 2

theorem weighted_primitive_bombieri_davenport_explicit (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ)

declarations.name: betaCovariance
declarations.complete_lexical_header: def betaCovariance (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.complete_primitive_definition:
def betaCovariance (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b ∈ betaReducedResidues (q.gcd r),
    (betaResidueMass N β q (q.gcd r) b -
      coprimeMass N β q / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ)) *
    (betaResidueMass N β r (q.gcd r) b -
      coprimeMass N β r / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ))

declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem betaResidueMass_centered_eq_coprimeAPDiscrepancy
    (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) {q δ b : ℕ}
    (hdq : δ ∣ q) (hb : b.Coprime δ) :
    betaResidueMass N β q δ b - coprimeMass N β q / (δ.totient : ℝ) =
      betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β δ (q / δ) b

theorem betaCovariance_abs_le_of_coprimeAP
    (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) (Eq Er : ℝ)
    (hEq : ∀ b ∈ betaReducedResidues (q.gcd r),
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β (q.gcd r) (q / q.gcd r) b| ≤ Eq)
    (hEr : ∀ b ∈ betaReducedResidues (q.gcd r),
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β (q.gcd r) (r / q.gcd r) b| ≤ Er) :
    |betaCovariance N β q r| ≤ ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ) * Eq * Er

declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_of_coprimeAP
    (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, q ≠ 0) (E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ d : ℕ, d ∣ q → 0 < d →
      ∀ b ∈ betaReducedResidues d,
        |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β d (q / d) b| ≤ E q d) :
    |smoothWMain M N Q β c a - smoothUMain M N Q β c a| ≤
      |M * dyadicCutoffMass| *
        ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, ∑ r ∈ reducedModuli Q a,
          |c q * c r / (q.lcm r : ℝ)| *
            (((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ) * E q (q.gcd r) * E r (q.gcd r))

declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem betaCovariance_abs_le_coprimeAP_lone
    (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) {q r : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)

declarations.name: BetaCoprimeSWFamily
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
def BetaCoprimeSWFamily {ι : Type*} (κ : ℕ) (T : ι → ℝ)
    (N : ι → Finset ℕ) (β : ι → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop
declarations.complete_primitive_definition:
def BetaCoprimeSWFamily {ι : Type*} (κ : ℕ) (T : ι → ℝ)
    (N : ι → Finset ℕ) (β : ι → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ i : ι, ∀ d h : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < h → ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime d →
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy (N i) (β i) d h b| ≤
        C * T i * (fouvryTau κ h : ℝ) / Real.log (2 * T i) ^ B

declarations.name: smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_SW
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_SW
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (j κ B : ℕ)
    {T L C : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊)
    (hQ : Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊) (β c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hβ : ∀ n ∈ N, |β n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) (a : ℤ)
    (hSW : ∀ d h : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < h → ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime d →
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β d h b| ≤
        C * T * (fouvryTau κ h : ℝ) / Real.log (2 * T) ^ B) :
    |smoothWMain M N Q β c a - smoothUMain M N Q β c a| ≤
      2 * |M * dyadicCutoffMass| * C * T ^ 2 *
        ((1 + Real.log T) ^ (k - 1) *
          (1 + Real.log L) ^ (2 * (j * (κ + 1)) ^ 2 + 1) /
            Real.log (2 * T) ^ B)

declarations.name: smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
    {ι : Type*} {κ k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (j A : ℕ)
    {T : ι → ℝ} {N : ι → Finset ℕ} {β : ι → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hSW : BetaCoprimeSWFamily κ T N β)
    (hT : ∀ i, 1 ≤ T i) (hN : ∀ i, N i ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T i⌋₊)
    (hβ : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N i, |β i n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ i : ι, T i ≤ x → x ^ ε ≤ T i →
      ∀ M L : ℝ, 1 ≤ L → L ≤ x →
      ∀ Q : Finset ℕ, Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊ →
      ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) →
      ∀ a : ℤ,
        |smoothWMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a - smoothUMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a| ≤
          |M| * T i ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ A

declarations.name: alpha_sq_mul_smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
declarations.complete_lexical_header:
theorem alpha_sq_mul_smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
    {ι : Type*} {κ k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (j A : ℕ)
    {T : ι → ℝ} {N : ι → Finset ℕ} {β : ι → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hSW : BetaCoprimeSWFamily κ T N β)
    (hT : ∀ i, 1 ≤ T i) (hN : ∀ i, N i ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T i⌋₊)
    (hβ : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N i, |β i n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ i : ι, ∀ M L : ℝ,
      1 ≤ M → 1 ≤ L → M * T i ≤ x → L ≤ x → x ^ ε ≤ T i →
      ∀ S Q : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, M ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M) →
      Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊ → ∀ α c : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, |α m| ≤ (fouvryTau ℓ m : ℝ)) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) → ∀ a : ℤ,
      (∑ m ∈ S, α m ^ 2) *
        |smoothWMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a - smoothUMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a| ≤
        x ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ A

declarations.name: sum_nonprincipal_by_conductor

theorem sum_nonprincipal_by_conductor
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (F : (d : ℕ) → PrimitiveCharacter d → ℝ) :
    (∑ χ ∈ nonprincipalCharacters q,
        F χ.conductor (conductorPrimitiveCharacter χ)) =
      ∑ d ∈ nonprincipalConductors q, ∑ ψ : PrimitiveCharacter d, F d ψ

declarations.name: weighted_sum_nonprincipal_by_conductor

theorem weighted_sum_nonprincipal_by_conductor
    (Q : ℕ) (F : (d : ℕ) → PrimitiveCharacter d → ℝ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
        ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
          ∑ χ ∈ nonprincipalCharacters q,
            F χ.conductor (conductorPrimitiveCharacter χ)) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 2 Q,
        imprimitiveConductorWeight Q d * ∑ ψ : PrimitiveCharacter d, F d ψ

declarations.name: weighted_allCharacter_nonprincipal_prefix_ledger

theorem weighted_allCharacter_nonprincipal_prefix_ledger
    (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ) (N Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        ∑ χ ∈ nonprincipalCharacters q, characterPrefixMaxSquare χ b M N) ≤
      2 * (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 2 Q,
        imprimitiveConductorWeight Q d *
          ∑ ψ : PrimitiveCharacter d,
            primitiveCharacterPrefixMaxSquare b M N d ψ) +
      8 * (N : ℝ) *
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
          ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
            ∑ _χ ∈ nonprincipalCharacters q,
              ∑ n ∈ conductorBadSupport q M N, ‖b n‖ ^ 2

theorem imprimitive_conductor_window_prefix_large_sieve_linear
    (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ) (N Q D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc D (2 * D),

        ∑ ψ : PrimitiveCharacter d,
          primitiveCharacterPrefixMaxSquare b M N d ψ) ≤
      ((Q / D : ℕ) : ℝ) * conductorHarmonicFactor (Q / D) *
        ((((Nat.log2 N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          primitiveLargeSieveConstant N (2 * D) *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖b n‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve
declarations.complete_lexical_header: def ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve (K : ℝ) : Prop
declarations.complete_primitive_definition:
def ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (R Q L : ℕ) (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ), 0 < R → 0 < Q →
    highConductorHarmonicTail R Q *
        highConductorPrimitiveSquareLedger R Q
          (fun d χ => Real.sqrt
            (primitiveCharacterPrefixMaxSquare b M L d χ)) ≤
      K ^ 2 * (((Nat.log2 L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        (((L : ℝ) * conductorLocalRowEnergy b M L) / R +
          (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 * conductorLocalRowEnergy b M L)

theorem highConductorPrimitiveRowMean_le_of_conductorLocal
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hLS : ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve K)
    (R Q L N : ℕ) (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hdiag : (L : ℝ) * conductorLocalRowEnergy b M L ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (henergy : conductorLocalRowEnergy b M L ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    highConductorPrimitiveMean R Q
        (fun d χ => Real.sqrt
          (primitiveCharacterPrefixMaxSquare b M L d χ)) ≤
      K * ((Nat.log2 L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ((N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt R + (Q : ℝ) * Real.sqrt N)

discovery_method.initial: Directed rg for AP discrepancy/mean-square/SW/BDH/conductor interfaces in primary source roots. Names, search nonmatches, olean files, and previous PASS labels are not theorem evidence.
discovery_method.semantic_followthrough: Read full relevant BombieriDavenport proof through 278; all finite covariance/AP definitions and covariance estimates through 350; SmallDelta through 215; full HighDelta; all ZeroModePayment types/proof payment; full ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve; conductor regrouping and weighted ledger through 367; linear imprimitive transport through 322; HighConductorDyadicPrimitive square/consumer proofs through 218. Remaining raw declaration discovery was used only to select candidates.
discovery_method.coverage_limit: No claim of a formally exhaustive theorem-nonexistence proof for every provider module. No suitable complete endpoint was identified in the inspected generic SW, AP covariance, conductor decomposition, and large-sieve chains. Specialized prime/Lambda distribution endpoints do not quantify over actual arbitrary complex alpha.
discovery_method.DAG: No foreign or global source-DAG census rerun. This audit changes no .lean imports. Reachability or prior owned status is not used to certify an external result.

conclusion.decision: Do not insert a generic mean-square supplier or count a source interface as payment. The desired composite-modulus, auxiliary-sieved weighted AP variance remains a new proved analytic step, unless the shared-p consumer is reorganized to avoid it.
genuine_unconditional_results: weighted_primitive_bombieri_davenport_explicit controls primitive characters for arbitrary complex interval coefficients with [N+(2ceil(log(Q^2)/log2)+12)Q^2] times coefficient L2. It has only Q>0; no residue support, roughness, a-size, or hidden analytic-supply premise appears in its lexical theorem type.

charParseval_units is exact all-character Parseval on units. Taking centered residue masses as T and removing its zero principal transform is finite algebra still to be connected to the actual AP variance; it is not a modulus-average analytic estimate.

sum_betaResidueMass_centered_sq_le_highDelta proves per-modulus centered variance <= coefficient L2 only under every supported n<delta. This cannot cover the remaining small physical gcd coordinate delta=p*d<=support endpoint 2U.

weighted_sum_nonprincipal_by_conductor exactly groups by primitive conductor. weighted_allCharacter_nonprincipal_prefix_ledger additionally retains the honest conductorBadSupport error. No estimate in that theorem pays this error from arbitrary auxiliary-SW data.

imprimitive_conductor_window_prefix_large_sieve_linear is a genuine unconditional dyadic conductor transport, but its output remains (Q/D) H(Q/D) (log2 N+1)^2 [N+O(D^2 log D)] times coefficient energy. It is not a completed log-saving centered-AP theorem.
conditional_non_suppliers: BetaCoprimeSWFamily is pointwise in every positive modulus d, auxiliary h, and reduced b; it is not a mean-square conclusion.

betaCovariance_abs_le_of_coprimeAP and betaCovariance_abs_le_coprimeAP_lone consume supplied AP error bounds. Their aggregate and SW logarithmic payment use all-positive-modulus pointwise input and ordinary complete-modulus lcm weights, not the new shared-p covariance sum.

ConductorLocalPrimitiveLargeSieve K is a Prop definition imposing the desired L/R square-ledger strengthening for every arbitrary row. highConductorPrimitiveRowMean_le_of_conductorLocal requires hLS plus explicit energy inequalities. It is not a theorem proving that Prop.

highConductorTypeI_le requires HighConductorTypeISquareSaving; the inverse sqrt R comes from that premise. The unconditional harmonic-Cauchy inequality supplies a harmonic tail, not an upper bound 1/R.

actual_dictionary_and_gap.coefficient: The paired sequence is original complex alpha on original alphaCarrier inside [U,2U]; transposed beta is its interval-zero extension. The exact transposedPairedSWError_eq_auxSWError keeps the same auxiliary k, AP modulus q, and residue b.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.uniform_quantifiers: Actual UniformAuxiliarySW chooses C and threshold before every family atom, k,q,b; error <= C U tau_2(k)^C0/log(scale)^A for all k,q>=1 and b coprime q. Provider BetaCoprimeSWFamily is real-valued and log(2T), so real/imag and upper-endpoint dictionaries must remain proved rather than silently substituted.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.shared_moduli: At fixed tails v1=q2*q3 and v2=r2*r3 let d=gcd(v1,v2). The physical moduli are p*v1,p*v2, with gcd=p*d and lcm=p*lcm(v1,v2), for arbitrary positive/composite p. The two relevant auxiliary sieves are h1=v1/d and h2=v2/d, independent of p for those fixed tails.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.requested_error_sum: The useful new object is a weighted sum over the full primitive first-factor carrier p~Q1 of reduced b modulo p*d of ||auxSWError(h_j,p*d,b)||^2, or its two-sided covariance counterpart, retaining h_j and all physical labels. Pointwise SW followed by summing p does not itself supply the missing Q1 normalization.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.primitive_gate: primitiveFirstFactorCarrier only imposes p coprime |a|; p is not required prime. The original gamma2/gamma3 gates and reduced class b guarantee needed unit conditions. Replacing p by primes discards authorized physical labels.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.residue: No signed a appears in the AP variance error itself. A theorem uniform over reduced b would accommodate moving signed a after the actual unit/CRT dictionary, without a separate |a| bound; none of the inspected finite LS types imposes an a-range.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.range: For an intended Maynard13.8-style theorem one must prove its exact Q<N/log(N)^C range after replacing modulus by p*d and length by 2U, with all d and auxiliary costs. The primary-paper range is not a Lean theorem in the inspected provider chain. No nu<=.1 gate arises in the genuine primitive LS theorem itself.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.why_primitive_LS_alone_fails: Centered AP variance contains every nonprincipal character of composite p*d, including characters induced from smaller conductors. The primitive LS does not control that entire set without a conductor decomposition and honest correction/payment. Neither p primitive-to-a nor paired coefficient roughness automatically makes those characters primitive.
actual_dictionary_and_gap.normalization_observation_not_a_provider: For prime p and d=1, exact nonprincipal Parseval plus 1/p<=1/Q on p~Q and primitive LS suggests (U/Q+Q)*alphaL2 up to logs. This is only a hand-derived special-case route, not an existing selected source theorem, and does not match arbitrary composite p, d, auxiliary h, or divisor weights.
remaining_proof_lanes: exact complex principal-subtracted residue Parseval for actual interval-zero coefficient and auxiliary coprime mask
composite p*d conductor/Mobius decomposition that preserves the true auxiliary sieve and controls its correction
uniform low-conductor payment from actual auxiliary-SW with constants before all atom/tail parameters
high-conductor dyadic LS normalization with a genuine inverse modulus factor and the permissible q-range
fixed divisor-weight payment and aggregation over the actual remaining tail/d coordinates without restoring the lost Q1

explicit_exclusions: No new theorem, analytic supplier, or desired-energy hypothesis has been added to the actual target.
No claim that a primary-paper citation supplies formal Lean proof.
No use of disputed Lichtman slow-phase deletion.
No reuse of independent-first-factor wGram as the shared-p row.
No claim that the surviving scalar bound proves an impossibility theorem for stronger local estimates.
